row: Center for Veterinary Pain Management and Rehabilitation

For many years, Dr. Rick Wall has been enthusiastically involved in the practice of physical medicine, rehabilitation and pain management in both dogs and cats. These years have been the most rewarding of his veterinary career, one which spans over thirty years. Dr. Wall developed a tremendous passion for both pain management and physical rehabilitation. Out of this passion, and his deep compassion for both clients and patients, Dr. Wall created the Center for Veterinary Pain Management and Rehabilitation in 2004. Subscribe to our channel to see the success of our patients as they begin to lead a better quality of life and learn about the great work being done here at #CVPMR. Thanks for visiting our page!
